WylonGenerateImage.description: Generate, wait for, and download one image through the synchronous image API. No task ID is returned.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Select a Wylon model. The API model ID is unchanged.

size.name: Image size
size.tooltip: Presets follow the selected model; server_default omits size.

1.name: Task ID
1.tooltip: Synchronous image generation returns no task ID; this output stays empty for workflow compatibility.

2.name: Local file path
2.tooltip: Local path of the downloaded result.

WylonH3Video.display_name: Wylon H3 Video (Text / First & Last Frames)
WylonH3Video.description: Submit a fixed MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 video task and wait. Use text alone or optional first/last frames.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the scene, action, camera and sound.

ratio.name: Aspect ratio
ratio.tooltip: server_default omits ratio. adaptive requires a first or last frame and omits the API ratio.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: -1 omits seed. Nonnegative values are forwarded to the video API. Reproducibility depends on the model.

control_after_generate.name: Next-run seed policy
control_after_generate.tooltip: Local policy updates the seed for the next queued run; it is never sent to Wylon.

first_frame.name: First frame
first_frame.tooltip: H3 only: connect exactly one image.

last_frame.name: Last frame
last_frame.tooltip: H3 only: connect exactly one image. Supports a last frame alone or first and last frames.

1.name: Task ID
1.tooltip: Existing asynchronous video task ID for retrieving this task result again.

2.name: Local file path
2.tooltip: Local path of the downloaded result.

WylonRef2VAVideo.description: Submit a fixed MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA task and wait. Connect reference images, dedicated reference-video URLs, and optional audio; audio requires an image or video.

seed.name: Seed

control_after_generate.name: Next-run seed policy
control_after_generate.tooltip: Local policy updates the seed for the next queued run; it is never sent to Wylon.

WylonResumeImageTask.description: Query a historical existing asynchronous image task, wait, and download its result. Runs standalone; repeated executions may save another copy. No new task is created.

task_id.name: Existing task ID
task_id.tooltip: Query and download an existing task of the matching media type. This does not create a new generation task.

1.name: Task ID
1.tooltip: Historical existing asynchronous image task ID for retrieving the original result again.

2.name: Local file path
2.tooltip: Local path of the downloaded result.

WylonResumeVideoTask.description: Query an existing video task, wait, and download its result. Runs standalone; repeated executions may save another copy. No new generation task is created.

task_id.name: Existing task ID

WylonReferenceVideoURL.description: Validate up to 3 public HTTPS video URLs for the dedicated Ref2VA reference-video input. One URL per line; empty means no video. Does not download, generate, or read an API key.

urls.name: Video URLs
urls.tooltip: Up to 3 public HTTPS video URLs, one per line. Empty means no reference video.
